name: openbb_yield_curve
description:
Treasury yield curve for one date (rate by maturity) through the OpenBB Platform (obb.fixedincome.government.yield_curve); rates are decimals.
Returns: {provider, date, yield_curve: [{date, maturity, rate, maturity_years}]} or {error}.
Inputs (* required): date (latest when omitted); provider (ecb, econdb, federal_reserve, fmp, fred; default federal_reserve).
Daily history per maturity: openbb_treasury_rates; euro area curve: provider ecb. Keys: ecb, econdb, federal_reserve need none; fmp uses SAJHA's FMP_API_KEY; fred uses SAJHA's FRED_API_KEY.
Example: {"date": "2026-09-30"}
